headline: Boris Nadezhdin is a rare Russian politician speaking out against the Ukraine war
context: Boris Nadezhdin wants to run for Russia's parliament on a platform that gives voice to the Russians against the war in Ukraine. That's why, he says, the Kremlin is doing everything to stop him.
